name: zynt
description: Set up ZYNT and ask for news on your lists. Signs in with your ZYNT account, no API key.

interface.shortDescription: Sales signals and news about the companies and people you sell to
interface.longDescription: ZYNT watches the market for news about the companies and people on your lists: funding, hires, expansions, tenders and events. This plugin connects your agent to ZYNT with your own sign-in, so it can set ZYNT up from what it knows about your business and tell you what changed on your lists. Learn more at https://getzynt.com.
defaultPrompt: Which companies on my list had news this week?
